method: Open public graphics engineering tasks selected independent of implementation and ranked output. Exact diagnostics count only if the specific normative predicate is cited. A positive requires an actionable external source on the mechanism; unrelated sources are incorrect. Negative claims are limited to the supplied public report. Independent on issue identities; stable old specification cases intentionally serve as controls alongside newer reports.

cases.title: Vulkan validation error when creating a 3D texture for compute shader writing + sampling with SDL3 GPU
cases.mechanism: Image-layout transitions must describe the preceding layout of the selected subresources.
cases.decision: Check the tracked 3D texture subresource layout before the transition. Use the actual previous layout, or UNDEFINED only when discarding the old contents is intentional.

sources.note: Instantiated by VkImageMemoryBarrier in the synchronization chapter. The clause answers the layout invariant, not which SDL transition broke it.

cases.title: Move RT validation to GPU-AV
cases.mechanism: Ray-tracing acceleration structure UPDATE requires matching prior primitive counts.
cases.decision: Tie the validation to the prior successful build and compare each geometry's range primitiveCount before accepting UPDATE.

sources.note: Instantiated by vkCmdBuildAccelerationStructuresKHR. Normative precondition for the requested migration to GPU-assisted validation.

cases.title: missing VUs for externally synchronized
cases.mechanism: Creation flag controls externally synchronized host access to a Vulkan pipeline cache.
cases.decision: Guard use of the same externally synchronized cache with host synchronization; classify this as flag-dependent and preserve the VUID scope of vkCreateGraphicsPipelines.

sources.note: Direct normative applicability, without claiming this graphics VUID also applies to merge operations.

cases.title: Support for D3D12CheckFeatureSupport (updated to report up to D3D12_FEATURE_DATA_D3D12_OPTIONS15)
cases.mechanism: D3D12 OPTIONS15 consumer behavior when CheckFeatureSupport fails.
cases.decision: Use the public helper as a runnable contract reference for the absent-capability case; it zeroes the options fields on failure. Separately check backend coverage before exposing any capability.

sources.note: Primary DirectX-Headers consumer implementation. The probe behavior is independently useful even if support in the issue project has since landed.

cases.title: GPU: STORAGE_READ vs SAMPLER
cases.mechanism: Typed UAV reads have separate D3D12 format capability predicates.
cases.decision: Keep storage reads distinct from sampled texture support in the capability matrix. Query TypedUAVLoadAdditionalFormats and the relevant per-format D3D12_FORMAT_SUPPORT2_UAV_TYPED_LOAD bit.

sources.note: Primary D3D12 guidance for typed UAV loads. Does not claim Metal/Vulkan equivalence or depth format support.

cases.title: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy - Deterministic 0xC0000005 crash in Chapter 11-5 (C_FURNACE / CP_MOVING_PLATFORM_START) on RADV GFX1201
cases.mechanism: An application-specific deterministic crash does not establish a backend mechanism.
cases.decision: Abstain from a fix or normative attribution without identifying the failing operation, a regression range or evidence that can distinguish the proposed mechanism.

cases.title: [mvk-error] VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST: Lost VkDevice after MTLCommandBuffer "vkQueueSubmit MTLCommandBuffer on Queue 0-0" execution failed (code 4): Ignored (for causing prior/excessive GPU errors)
cases.mechanism: Vulkan device loss reported after a Metal command buffer error is a catch-all symptom.
cases.decision: Abstain from proposing a generic vkQueueSubmit contract as the fix. First correlate the failing commands and driver/backend/configuration differences.
